# F10: People, Teams and About on a phone: the first person and the first fact near the top, short Teams rows with no buttons, nothing scrolls sideways

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/10-people.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

People and Teams on a phone (app redesign WR1, docs/design/workspace/spec.md section 6). run({ open }) returns a list of failures. At 390 px, as a member: the first person on People is near the top; a Teams row's counts start on its third line and it has no button in it; and nothing on People, Teams, a person, a team or a Workspace section scrolls sideways. About's first fact is within 260 px of the top (the spec's 220 left no room for the phone's top bar and Workspace's one line; settled against the real page in WR2).

## Where it looks

- 390 × 844, as oskar, at `/people`, on a touch screen

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
